items.title: DPRK Hackers Use ClickFix to Deliver BeaverTail Malware in Crypto Job Scams
items.description: Threat actors with ties to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (aka DPRK or North Korea) have been observed leveraging ClickFix-style lures to deliver a known malware called BeaverTail and InvisibleFerret. items.title: New EDR-Freeze Tool That Puts EDRs and Antivirus Into A Coma State
items.description: A new proof-of-concept tool named EDR-Freeze has been developed, capable of placing Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and antivirus solutions into a suspended “coma” state.
